newsitem.title: FRANCE: 345 held in France in mass paedophilia crackdown.
newsitem.headline: 345 held in France in mass paedophilia crackdown.

text.p: French gendarmes detained 345 people on Tuesday in a nationwide crackdown on paedophile video fans, a spokesman for the paramilitary police said.
He said that 14 months of investigation had led the gendarmerie to a mail-order company in the central town of Macon selling pornographic films involving boys.

The operation, launched early in the morning, involved some 2,500 gendarmes who fanned out across mainland France as well as overseas territories to search the homes of 800 people whose names were found on the company's mailing list.
Gendarmes seized 250 pornographic cassettes which the company had bought outside of France, mainly in Spain and Poland, and then copied.
The crackdown coincides with France's first major paedophilia trial, which opened in Paris on Monday.
Seventy-one Frenchmen are accused of organising or subscribing to a network selling pornographic films involving boys.

Two of the main suspects, Miguel Caignet, 42, accused of promoting the cassettes in pornographic magazines, and Michel Meigniez, also 42, charged with organising their distribution, said they thought the boys in the films were over 18.
But lawyers for the civil plaintiffs say the young Colombians in the videos were paid to lie about their age. The trial is expected to continue until early July.
